topic: RF exposure and station safety (G0A, G0B; 25 pool questions)

questions.question: What is one way that RF energy can affect human body tissue?

choices.A: It heats body tissue
choices.B: It causes radiation poisoning
choices.C: It causes the blood count to reach a dangerously low level

questions.answer: It heats body tissue

questions.question: Which of the following is used to determine RF exposure from a transmitted signal?

choices.A: Its duty cycle
choices.B: Its frequency
choices.C: Its power density

questions.answer: All these choices are correct

questions.question: How can you determine that your station complies with FCC RF exposure regulations?

choices.A: By calculation based on FCC OET Bulletin 65
choices.B: By calculation based on computer modeling
choices.C: By measurement of field strength using calibrated equipment

questions.answer: All these choices are correct

questions.question: What does “time averaging” mean when evaluating RF radiation exposure?

choices.A: The average amount of power developed by the transmitter over a specific 24-hour period
choices.B: The average time it takes RF radiation to have any long-term effect on the body
choices.C: The total time of the exposure
choices.D: The total RF exposure averaged over a certain period

questions.answer: The total RF exposure averaged over a certain period

questions.question: What must you do if an evaluation of your station shows that the RF energy radiated by your station exceeds permissible limits for possible human absorption?

choices.A: Take action to prevent human exposure to the excessive RF fields
choices.B: File an Environmental Impact Statement (EIS-97) with the FCC
choices.C: Secure written permission from your neighbors to operate above the controlled MPE limits

questions.answer: Take action to prevent human exposure to the excessive RF fields

questions.question: What must you do if your station fails to meet the FCC RF exposure exemption criteria?

choices.A: Perform an RF exposure evaluation in accordance with FCC OET Bulletin 65
choices.B: Contact the FCC for permission to transmit
choices.C: Perform an RF exposure evaluation in accordance with World Meteorological Organization guidelines

questions.answer: Perform an RF exposure evaluation in accordance with FCC OET Bulletin 65

questions.question: What is the effect of modulation duty cycle on RF exposure?

choices.A: A lower duty cycle permits greater power levels to be transmitted
choices.B: A higher duty cycle permits greater power levels to be transmitted
choices.C: Low duty cycle transmitters are exempt from RF exposure evaluation requirements
choices.D: High duty cycle transmitters are exempt from RF exposure requirements

questions.answer: A lower duty cycle permits greater power levels to be transmitted

questions.question: Which of the following steps must an amateur operator take to ensure compliance with RF safety regulations?

choices.A: Post a copy of FCC Part 97.13 in the station
choices.B: Notify neighbors within a 100-foot radius of the antenna of the existence of the station and power levels
choices.C: Perform a routine RF exposure evaluation and prevent access to any identified high exposure areas

questions.answer: Perform a routine RF exposure evaluation and prevent access to any identified high exposure areas

questions.question: What type of instrument can be used to accurately measure an RF field strength?

choices.A: A receiver with digital signal processing (DSP) noise reduction
choices.B: A calibrated field strength meter with a calibrated antenna
choices.C: An SWR meter with a peak-reading function
choices.D: An oscilloscope with a high-stability crystal marker generator

questions.answer: A calibrated field strength meter with a calibrated antenna

questions.question: What should be done if evaluation shows that a neighbor might experience more than the allowable limit of RF exposure from the main lobe of a directional antenna?

choices.A: Change to a non-polarized antenna with higher gain
choices.B: Use an antenna with a higher front-to-back ratio
choices.C: Take precautions to ensure that the antenna cannot be pointed in their direction when they are present

questions.answer: Take precautions to ensure that the antenna cannot be pointed in their direction when they are present

questions.question: What precaution should be taken if you install an indoor transmitting antenna?

choices.A: Locate the antenna close to your operating position to minimize feed-line radiation
choices.B: Position the antenna along the edge of a wall to reduce parasitic radiation
choices.C: Make sure that MPE limits are not exceeded in occupied areas
choices.D: Make sure the antenna is properly shielded

questions.answer: Make sure that MPE limits are not exceeded in occupied areas

questions.question: What stations are subject to the FCC rules on RF exposure?

choices.A: All commercial stations; amateur radio stations are exempt
choices.B: Only stations with antennas lower than one wavelength above the ground
choices.C: Only stations transmitting more than 500 watts PEP
choices.D: All stations with a time-averaged transmission of more than one milliwatt

questions.answer: All stations with a time-averaged transmission of more than one milliwatt

questions.question: Which wire or wires in a four-conductor 240 VAC circuit should be attached to fuses or circuit breakers?

choices.A: Only the hot wires
choices.B: Only the neutral wire
choices.C: Only the ground wire

questions.answer: Only the hot wires

questions.question: According to the National Electrical Code, what is the minimum wire size that may be used safely for wiring with a 20-ampere circuit breaker?

choices.A: AWG number 20
choices.B: AWG number 16
choices.C: AWG number 12

questions.answer: AWG number 12

questions.question: Which size of fuse or circuit breaker would be appropriate to use with a circuit that uses AWG number 14 wiring?

choices.A: 30 amperes
choices.B: 25 amperes
choices.C: 20 amperes

questions.answer: 15 amperes

questions.question: Where should the station’s lightning protection ground system be located?

choices.A: As close to the station equipment as possible
choices.B: Outside the building
choices.C: Next to the closest power pole
choices.D: Parallel to the water supply line

questions.answer: Outside the building

questions.question: Which of the following conditions will cause a ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) to disconnect AC power?

choices.A: Current flowing from one or more of the hot wires to the neutral wire
choices.B: Current flowing from one or more of the hot wires directly to ground
choices.C: Overvoltage on the hot wires

questions.answer: Current flowing from one or more of the hot wires directly to ground

questions.question: Which of the following is covered by the National Electrical Code?

choices.A: Acceptable bandwidth limits
choices.B: Acceptable modulation limits
choices.C: Electrical safety of the station
choices.D: RF exposure limits of the human body

questions.answer: Electrical safety of the station

questions.question: Which of these choices should be observed when climbing a tower using a safety harness?

choices.A: Always hold on to the tower with one hand
choices.B: Confirm that the harness is rated for the weight of the climber and that it is within its allowable service life
choices.C: Ensure that all heavy tools are securely fastened to the harness

questions.answer: Confirm that the harness is rated for the weight of the climber and that it is within its allowable service life

questions.question: What should be done before climbing a tower that supports electrically powered devices?

choices.A: Notify the electric company that a person will be working on the tower
choices.B: Make sure all circuits that supply power to the tower are locked out and tagged
choices.C: Unground the base of the tower

questions.answer: Make sure all circuits that supply power to the tower are locked out and tagged

questions.question: Which of the following is true of an emergency generator installation?

choices.A: The generator should be operated in a well-ventilated area
choices.B: The generator must be insulated from ground
choices.C: Fuel should be stored near the generator for rapid refueling in case of an emergency

questions.answer: The generator should be operated in a well-ventilated area

questions.question: Which of the following is a danger from lead-tin solder?

choices.A: Lead can contaminate food if hands are not washed carefully after handling the solder
choices.B: High voltages can cause lead-tin solder to disintegrate suddenly
choices.C: Tin in the solder can “cold flow,” causing shorts in the circuit
choices.D: RF energy can convert the lead into a poisonous gas

questions.answer: Lead can contaminate food if hands are not washed carefully after handling the solder

questions.question: Which of the following is required for lightning protection ground rods?

choices.A: They must be bonded to all buried water and gas lines
choices.B: Bends in ground wires must be made as close as possible to a right angle
choices.C: Lightning grounds must be connected to all ungrounded wiring
choices.D: They must be bonded together with all other grounds

questions.answer: They must be bonded together with all other grounds

questions.question: What is the purpose of a power supply interlock?

choices.A: To prevent unauthorized changes to the circuit that would void the manufacturer’s warranty
choices.B: To shut down the unit if it becomes too hot
choices.C: To ensure that dangerous voltages are removed if the cabinet is opened
choices.D: To shut off the power supply if too much voltage is produced

questions.answer: To ensure that dangerous voltages are removed if the cabinet is opened

questions.question: Where should lightning arrestors be located?

choices.A: Where the feed lines enter the building
choices.B: On the antenna, opposite the feed point
choices.C: In series with each ground lead
choices.D: At the closest power pole ground electrode

questions.answer: Where the feed lines enter the building
